symptom: The broad 0-60s caramel-workshop edge-recovery branch passed the target seed preflight for caramel-workshop:63402 and passed the 60s/caramel-workshop hard preflight, but failed the full 60/180/300s high-pressure parent no-regression check against the unbranched base report. The validator reported 2 blockers: 180s/caramel-workshop action_distribution_l1_delta 0.4813 above the 0.45 cap and 300s/caramel-workshop action_distribution_l1_delta 0.5787 above the 0.45 cap.
root_cause: The broad opening branch is scoped to caramel-workshop and only triggers 3 times in the opening window, but those early interventions change the later caramel-workshop trajectory enough to create long-window action distribution drift. The short-window improvement reduces action 5 at 60s, but the 180s and 300s windows show action 5 increasing by 0.1270 and 0.1940 relative to the unbranched base, so the branch does not preserve the parent policy shape.
fix: Reject the 0-60s broad branch as a follow-up candidate and do not run a 10 seed caramel promotion from it. The next repair should use a narrower state-conditioned dispatch or an online action-distribution guard that keeps the target seed action 5 reduction without creating 180s/300s caramel action 5 drift. Any revised branch must rerun target seed preflight, 60s/caramel hard preflight, and high-pressure 60/180/300s parent no-regression before a 10 seed follow-up.
validation: Ran high-pressure comparisons for the broad 0-60s branch at 180s and 300s, combined with the previously recorded 60s branch report. Then ran validate_policy_window_regression.py against the unbranched base reports with min_win_rate_delta 0.0, max_survival_drop_seconds 5.0, max_dominant_ratio_increase 0.2, max_action_ratio_increase 0.2, max_action_distribution_l1_delta 0.45, and max_normalized_entropy_drop 0.15.
